# pulse_client (Data Source)

Looks up a client (created in the dashboard or elsewhere) by ID or name, for example to name its durable consumer (`<id>_<name>`). Its credentials are never readable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A client created in the dashboard: give it a consumer managed here.
data "pulse_client" "legacy_bot" {
  name = "legacy-bot"
}

resource "pulse_consumer" "legacy_bot" {
  name            = "${data.pulse_client.legacy_bot.id}_main"
  filter_subjects = ["evt.legacy.>"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Client ID. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Client name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `expires_at` (String) When the credentials expire (RFC 3339).
- `grants` (Attributes Set) Grants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))
- `status` (String) `active`, `expired` or `revoked`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags.
- `user_key` (String) Current NATS user public key.

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Action.
- `name` (String) Durable name (durable grants).
- `stream` (String) Stream (subscribe and durable grants).
- `subject` (String) Subject pattern.
